# Tools Overview

Nutri-MCP exposes **38 tools** (plus `estimateNutritionFromText` when Nutritionix is configured). All tools are read-only and return both `structuredContent` (validated against an `outputSchema`) and a JSON text block.

| Category | Tool | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| [Product](#product-tools) | [`getProductByBarcode`](#getproductbybarcode) | Get the full product record for a barcode: name, brand, nutrients per 100 g (and per serving), Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA group, ingredients, allergens and additives |
| [Product](#product-tools) | [`searchProducts`](#searchproducts) | Search food products by text, brand and/or category, optionally limited to a maximum Nutri-Score grade or NOVA group |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`analyzeNutrition`](#analyzenutrition) | Complete nutritional analysis of a product per 100 g: calories, macro split, % Daily Values, UK FSA traffic lights, concerns (high fat/saturates/sugars/salt) and benefits (good/excellent sources) |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`getNutriScore`](#getnutriscore) | Get the Nutri-Score grade (A-E) with its points breakdown (2023 algorithm when available: negative points for energy, sugars, saturated fat, salt; positive points for fiber, protein, fruits/vegetables/legumes) |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`getGreenScore`](#getgreenscore) | Get the Green-Score (formerly Eco-Score) environmental impact grade (A+ best to F worst) and score, from Open Food Facts life-cycle analysis |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`calculateDailyIntake`](#calculatedailyintake) | Nutrients and % Daily Values for a given number of servings (uses the labelled serving size, or `grams` when given) |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`getMacroBreakdown`](#getmacrobreakdown) | Macronutrient breakdown per 100 g: grams, calories and share of energy from protein, carbohydrates and fat |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`getNutrientDensity`](#getnutrientdensity) | Nutrient density score: sum of % Daily Value of beneficial nutrients (fiber, protein, vitamins, minerals) per 100 kcal |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`analyzeMeal`](#analyzemeal) | Combined nutrition of several products eaten together |
| [Nutrition](#nutrition-tools) | [`getNovaGroup`](#getnovagroup) | NOVA food processing classification (1 = unprocessed ... 4 = ultra-processed) for a product |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`checkAllergen`](#checkallergen) | Check whether a product contains (or may contain traces of) a specific allergen |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`checkMultipleAllergens`](#checkmultipleallergens) | Check a product against a list of allergens at once |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`checkBig9`](./allergen.md#checkbig9) | Check a product against the US FDA "Big 9" major allergens (milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame) |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`checkEU14`](./allergen.md#checkeu14) | Check a product against the 14 major allergens of EU Regulation 1169/2011 |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`getAllAllergens`](#getallallergens) | List every allergen declared for a product: confirmed, "may contain" and traces |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`getCrossContaminationRisk`](#getcrosscontaminationrisk) | Assess cross-contamination risk from trace declarations and "may contain" / shared-facility warnings on the label |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`checkDietCompliance`](#checkdietcompliance) | Check whether a product fits a diet (vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, keto, paleo, gluten_free, dairy_free, low_sodium, low_sugar, halal, kosher) |
| [Allergen & Diet](#allergen--diet-tools) | [`getAdditivesInfo`](#getadditivesinfo) | Additives (E-numbers) in a product with names, functions (e.g. emulsifier, preservative) and EFSA over-exposure risk |
| [Comparison](#comparison-tools) | [`compareProducts`](#compareproducts) | Compare 2-5 products side by side (Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA and key nutrients per 100 g) and pick the healthier option |
| [Comparison](#comparison-tools) | [`findHealthierAlternative`](#findhealthieralternative) | Find a healthier alternative to a product (better Nutri-Score, less processed, less salt/sugar/saturated fat, more fiber/protein) |
| [Comparison](#comparison-tools) | [`compareNutrientDensity`](#comparenutrientdensity) | Rank products by nutrient density (% Daily Value of beneficial nutrients per 100 kcal) |
| [Comparison](#comparison-tools) | [`rankByNutrient`](#rankbynutrient) | Rank products by one nutrient per 100 g (e.g. highest protein, lowest sugars) |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`getProductPrices`](#getproductprices) | Most recent crowdsourced prices for a product (newest first), with store and location |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`searchPrices`](#searchprices) | Search crowdsourced prices by product, currency, country, date and discount status |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`getPriceStats`](#getpricestats) | Min, max, average, median and latest price for a product, computed separately for each currency |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`findBestPrice`](#findbestprice) | Lowest recent price for a product in each currency, with the store where it was seen |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`comparePrices`](#compareprices) | Compare median and best prices of several products in one currency, including price per kg/L to find the best value |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`getRecentPrices`](#getrecentprices) | Prices most recently added by the Open Prices community, optionally filtered by currency or country |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`getPriceHistory`](#getpricehistory) | Monthly median price of a product over the last months, per currency, to spot price trends |
| [Price](#price-tools) | [`findDeals`](#finddeals) | Recently reported discounted prices (promotions), optionally for one product, currency or country |
| [Recipe & Meal](#recipe--meal-tools) | [`suggestRecipes`](#suggestrecipes) | Recipe ideas that use a product, based on its categories, plus whether the product itself fits the requested diets |
| [Recipe & Meal](#recipe--meal-tools) | [`substituteIngredient`](#substituteingredient) | Common substitutes for an ingredient (butter, egg, milk, cream, cheese, flour, sugar, honey, gelatin, soy sauce, breadcrumbs), filterable by need |
| [Recipe & Meal](#recipe--meal-tools) | [`analyzeMealPlan`](#analyzemealplan) | Calories and macros per meal and for the whole day |
| [Recipe & Meal](#recipe--meal-tools) | [`calculateMealCost`](#calculatemealcost) | Estimated cost of a meal from crowdsourced median prices in one currency |
| [Insights](#insights-tools) | [`getProductInsights`](#getproductinsights) | Machine-learning predictions about a product from Open Food Facts Robotoff (e.g. suggested categories, labels, brands) that are not yet confirmed |
| [Insights](#insights-tools) | [`getAIQuestions`](#getaiquestions) | Yes/no questions generated by Robotoff that need human verification, for one product or random products |
| [Insights](#insights-tools) | [`qualityCheck`](#qualitycheck) | Check how complete the data for a product is (nutrients, scores, ingredients, allergens, images) and what is missing |
| [Safety](#safety-tools) | [`checkRecalls`](#checkrecalls) | Search US FDA food recall / enforcement reports (openFDA) by barcode and/or product text |



## Product Tools

Look up and search food products. Start here to get barcodes.

### getProductByBarcode

**Get product by barcode** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Get the full product record for a barcode: name, brand, nutrients per 100 g (and per serving), Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA group, ingredients, allergens and additives. Data from Open Food Facts, merged with USDA/Nutritionix when configured.

> Hosts that support MCP Apps render this result as an interactive card.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object

#### Example

### searchProducts

**Search products** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Search food products by text, brand and/or category, optionally limited to a maximum Nutri-Score grade or NOVA group. Returns summaries with barcodes; use getProductByBarcode for details.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | string | No | Free text, e.g. "greek yogurt" |
| `brand` | string | No | Brand name, e.g. "Danone" |
| `category` | string | No | Category name or OFF tag, e.g. "breakfast cereals" or "en:breakfast-cereals" |
| `nutriScoreMax` | `A` \| `B` \| `C` \| `D` \| `E` | No | Worst acceptable Nutri-Score grade (e.g. "B" returns A and B) |
| `novaMax` | integer | No | Most processed acceptable NOVA group (1–4) |
| `page` | integer | No |  (1–100, default `1`) |
| `pageSize` | integer | No |  (1–50, default `20`) |

#### Output

- `items`: object[]
- `pagination`: object
- `sources`: string[]

#### Example

```json
// searchProducts({"query":"nutella","pageSize":3})
{
  "items": [
    {
      "barcode": "0009800800049",
      "name": "Nutella & go! hazelnut spread + breadsticks",
      "brand": "Nutella",
      "categories": [
        "snacks"
      ],
      "nutriScoreGrade": "E",
      "novaGroup": 3,
      "thumbnail": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/000/980/080/0049/front_en.5.200.jpg",
      "sources": [
        "openfoodfacts"
      ]
    },
    {
      "barcode": "0098008952506",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "brand": "Nutella",
      "categories": [],
      "thumbnail": "https://images.openfoodfacts.org/images/products/009/800/895/2506/front_en.3.200.jpg",
      "sources": [
        "openfoodfacts"
      ]
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 3,
    "totalItems": 631,
    "totalPages": 211,
    "hasNext": true,
    "hasPrev": false
  },
  "sources": [
    "openfoodfacts"
  ]
}
```



## Nutrition Tools

Nutrients, Daily Values, Nutri-Score, Green-Score and NOVA. Values are per 100 g unless stated.

### analyzeNutrition

**Analyze nutrition** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Complete nutritional analysis of a product per 100 g: calories, macro split, % Daily Values, UK FSA traffic lights, concerns (high fat/saturates/sugars/salt) and benefits (good/excellent sources).

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `calories`: number
- `macros`: object
- `nutrients`: object[]
- `dailyValueSummary`: object
- `trafficLights`: object
- `concerns`: object[]
- `benefits`: object[]
- `basis`: string

#### Example

```json
{

    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"

  "calories": 539,

      "percent": 43
    },

      "grams": 30.9,

      "percent": 52
    }
  },
  "nutrients": [
    {
      "id": "energy_kcal",
      "name": "Energy",
      "value": 539,
      "unit": "kcal",
      "per100g": 539,
      "dailyValuePercent": 27,
      "source": "openfoodfacts"
    },
    {
      "id": "energy_kj",
      "name": "Energy",
      "value": 2252,
      "unit": "kJ",
      "per100g": 2252,

    "… 9 more"

    "fat": "high",
```

### getNutriScore

**Get Nutri-Score** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Get the Nutri-Score grade (A-E) with its points breakdown (2023 algorithm when available: negative points for energy, sugars, saturated fat, salt; positive points for fiber, protein, fruits/vegetables/legumes).

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `available`: boolean
- `nutriScore` (optional): object
- `meaning` (optional): string

#### Example

```json
// getNutriScore({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "available": true,
  "nutriScore": {
    "grade": "E",
    "score": 20,
    "version": "2023",
    "positive": [
      {
        "id": "fiber",
        "value": 4,
        "unit": "g",
        "points": 1,
        "pointsMax": 5
      },
      {
        "id": "fruits_vegetables_legumes",
        "value": 0,
        "unit": "%",
        "points": 0,
        "pointsMax": 5
      }
    ],
    "negative": [
      {
        "id": "energy",
        "value": 1962,
        "unit": "kJ",
        "points": 5,
        "pointsMax": 10
      },
      {
        "id": "sugars",
        "value": 32,
        "unit": "g",
        "points": 9,
        "pointsMax": 15
      },
      "… 2 more"
    ]
  },
  "meaning": "Lowest nutritional quality"
}
```

### getGreenScore

**Get Green-Score** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Get the Green-Score (formerly Eco-Score) environmental impact grade (A+ best to F worst) and score, from Open Food Facts life-cycle analysis.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `available`: boolean
- `greenScore` (optional): object

#### Example

```json
// getGreenScore({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"
  },
  "available": true,
  "greenScore": {
    "grade": "F",
    "score": -4
  }
}
```

### calculateDailyIntake

**Calculate daily intake** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Nutrients and % Daily Values for a given number of servings (uses the labelled serving size, or `grams` when given).

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `servings` | number | No | Number of servings (–50, default `1`) |
| `grams` | number | No | Override serving size in grams (–5000) |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `servings`: number
- `gramsPerServing`: number
- `servingSource`: `label` \| `input` \| `default_100g`
- `totalGrams`: number
- `nutrients`: object[]

#### Example

```json
// calculateDailyIntake({"barcode":"7622210449283","servings":2})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "servings": 2,
  "gramsPerServing": 20,
  "servingSource": "label",
  "totalGrams": 40,
  "nutrients": [
    {
      "id": "energy_kcal",
      "name": "Energy",
      "amount": 186.8,
      "unit": "kcal",
      "dailyValuePercent": 9.4
    },
    {
      "id": "energy_kj",
      "name": "Energy",
      "amount": 784.8,
      "unit": "kJ"
    },
    "… 9 more"
  ]
}
```

### getNutrientDensity

**Get nutrient density** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Nutrient density score: sum of % Daily Value of beneficial nutrients (fiber, protein, vitamins, minerals) per 100 kcal.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `calories`: number
- `nutrientDensityScore`: number
- `interpretation`: string

#### Example

```json
// getNutrientDensity({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "calories": 467,
  "nutrientDensityScore": 6,
  "interpretation": "Low nutrient density"
}
```

### analyzeMeal

**Analyze meal** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Combined nutrition of several products eaten together. Give portion sizes in grams (same order as barcodes); 100 g is assumed when omitted.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes in the meal (1–20 items) |
| `grams` | number[] | No | Portion in grams for each barcode (0–20 items) |

#### Output

- `items`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]
- `totalGrams`: number
- `totalCalories`: number
- `totals`: object[]
- `macros`: object

#### Example

```json
// analyzeMeal({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"],"grams":[15,40]})
{
  "items": [
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "grams": 15,
      "calories": 81
    },
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "grams": 40,
      "calories": 187
    }
  ],
  "missing": [],
  "totalGrams": 55,
  "totalCalories": 268,
  "totals": [
    {
      "id": "energy_kcal",
      "amount": 267.65,
      "unit": "kcal",
      "dailyValuePercent": 13.4
    },
    {
      "id": "energy_kj",
      "amount": 1122.6,
      "unit": "kJ"
    },
    "… 9 more"
  ],
  "macros": {
    "protein": {
      "grams": 3.465,
      "calories": 13.9,
      "percent": 5
    },
    "carbs": {
      "grams": 36.225,
      "calories": 144.9,
      "percent": 55
    },
    "fat": {
      "grams": 11.435,
      "calories": 102.9,
      "percent": 39
    }
  }
}
```

### getNovaGroup

**Get NOVA group** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

NOVA food processing classification (1 = unprocessed ... 4 = ultra-processed) for a product.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `novaGroup` (optional): integer
- `description`: string
- `ultraProcessed` (optional): boolean

#### Example

```json
// getNovaGroup({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "novaGroup": 4,
  "description": "Ultra-processed food and drink products",
  "ultraProcessed": true
}
```



## Allergen & Diet Tools

Allergens (FDA Big 9, EU 14), cross-contamination, diet compatibility and additives. Based on label data, which can be incomplete.

### checkAllergen

**Check allergen** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Check whether a product contains (or may contain traces of) a specific allergen.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `allergen` | `gluten` \| `wheat` \| `dairy` \| `eggs` \| `fish` \| `shellfish` \| `mollusks` \| `tree_nuts` \| `peanuts` \| `soy` \| `celery` \| `mustard` \| `sesame` \| `sulfites` \| `lupin` | Yes | Allergen to check |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `result`: object
- `dataAvailable`: boolean
- `message`: string
- `disclaimer`: string

#### Example

```json
// checkAllergen({"barcode":"3017620422003","allergen":"dairy"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"
  },
  "result": {
    "safe": false,
    "allergen": "dairy",
    "found": {
      "id": "dairy",
      "name": "dairy",
      "certainty": "confirmed"
    },
    "inTraces": false
  },
  "dataAvailable": true,
  "message": "WARNING: Nutella contains dairy",
  "disclaimer": "Based on declared label data, which can be incomplete. People with severe allergies should always check the physical package."
}
```

### checkMultipleAllergens

**Check multiple allergens** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Check a product against a list of allergens at once.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `allergens` | `gluten` \| `wheat` \| `dairy` \| `eggs` \| `fish` \| `shellfish` \| `mollusks` \| `tree_nuts` \| `peanuts` \| `soy` \| `celery` \| `mustard` \| `sesame` \| `sulfites` \| `lupin`[] | Yes | Allergens to check (1–15 items) |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `overallSafe`: boolean
- `allergensFound`: string[]
- `results`: object[]
- `dataAvailable`: boolean
- `disclaimer`: string

#### Example

```json
// checkMultipleAllergens({"barcode":"7622210449283","allergens":["wheat","peanuts"]})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "overallSafe": false,
  "allergensFound": [
    "wheat"
  ],
  "results": [
    {
      "safe": false,
      "allergen": "wheat",
      "found": {
        "id": "wheat",
        "name": "wheat",
        "certainty": "may_contain"
      },
      "inTraces": false,
      "note": "Contains gluten; wheat cannot be ruled out"
    },
    {
      "safe": true,
      "allergen": "peanuts",
      "found": null,
      "inTraces": false
    }
  ],
  "dataAvailable": true,
  "disclaimer": "Based on declared label data, which can be incomplete. People with severe allergies should always check the physical package."
}
```

### getAllAllergens

**Get all allergens** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

List every allergen declared for a product: confirmed, "may contain" and traces.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `confirmed`: object[]
- `mayContain`: object[]
- `traces`: object[]

```json
// getAllAllergens({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{

  },

    {
      "id": "eggs",
      "name": "eggs",
      "certainty": "confirmed"
    },
    {

    },

      "certainty": "traces"
    }
  ],

  "dataAvailable": true
}
```

### getCrossContaminationRisk

**Get cross-contamination risk** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Assess cross-contamination risk from trace declarations and "may contain" / shared-facility warnings on the label.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `risk`: `low` \| `medium` \| `high` \| `unknown`
- `factors`: string[]
- `disclaimer`: string

#### Example

```json
// getCrossContaminationRisk({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "risk": "high",
  "factors": [
    "May contain traces of: eggs",
    "Label warning: \"peut contenir\""
  ],
  "disclaimer": "Based on declared label data, which can be incomplete. People with severe allergies should always check the physical package."
}
```

### checkDietCompliance

**Check diet compliance** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Check whether a product fits a diet (vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, keto, paleo, gluten_free, dairy_free, low_sodium, low_sugar, halal, kosher). Returns compliant / not_compliant / uncertain with the evidence used.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `diet` | `vegan` \| `vegetarian` \| `pescatarian` \| `keto` \| `paleo` \| `gluten_free` \| `dairy_free` \| `low_sodium` \| `low_sugar` \| `halal` \| `kosher` | Yes | Diet to check |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `diet`: string
- `compliant`: boolean
- `verdict`: `compliant` \| `not_compliant` \| `uncertain`
- `violations`: string[]
- `warnings`: string[]
- `basis`: string[]
- `message`: string

#### Example

```json
// checkDietCompliance({"barcode":"3017620422003","diet":"vegan"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"
  },
  "compliant": false,
  "verdict": "not_compliant",
  "diet": "vegan",
  "violations": [
    "Contains dairy"
  ],
  "warnings": [
    "Some ingredients may not be vegan"
  ],
  "basis": [
    "Open Food Facts ingredient analysis: vegan = maybe"
  ],
  "message": "Nutella is NOT compatible with a vegan diet"
}
```

### getAdditivesInfo

**Get additives info** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Additives (E-numbers) in a product with names, functions (e.g. emulsifier, preservative) and EFSA over-exposure risk.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|

```json
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "count": 4,
  "additives": [
    {
      "code": "E322",
      "name": "E322 - Lecithins",

    },
    {

      "classes": [
        "antioxidant",
        "emulsifier"
      ],
      "vegan": "maybe",
      "vegetarian": "maybe"
    },
    "… 2 more"
  ],
  "highRiskCount": 0,

}
```



## Comparison Tools

Compare products and find healthier alternatives.

### compareProducts

**Compare products** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Compare 2-5 products side by side (Nutri-Score, Green-Score, NOVA and key nutrients per 100 g) and pick the healthier option.

> Hosts that support MCP Apps render this result as an interactive card.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | 2-5 product barcodes (2–5 items) |

#### Output

- `products`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]
- `winner` (optional): object
- `summary`: string
- `keyNutrients`: object[]

#### Example

```json
// compareProducts({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"]})
{
  "products": [
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "brand": "Nutella, Ferrero",
      "greenScore": "F",
      "novaGroup": 3
    },
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "brand": "Mondelez Schweiz GmbH",
      "nutriScore": "E",
      "greenScore": "E",
      "novaGroup": 4
    }
  ],
  "missing": [],
  "winner": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "reason": "Per 100 g: fewer calories, less saturated fat, less sugar, more fiber"
  },
  "summary": "Comparison of Nutella vs Prince: Prince is the healthier choice. Per 100 g: fewer calories, less saturated fat, less sugar, more fiber.",
  "keyNutrients": [
    {
      "id": "energy_kcal",
      "name": "Energy",
      "unit": "kcal",
      "values": {
        "3017620422003": 539,
        "7622210449283": 467
      },
      "better": "7622210449283"
    },
    {
      "id": "fat",
      "name": "Fat",
      "unit": "g",
      "values": {
        "3017620422003": 30.9,
        "7622210449283": 17
      },
      "better": "7622210449283"
    },
    "… 5 more"
  ]
}
```

### findHealthierAlternative

**Find healthier alternative** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Find a healthier alternative to a product (better Nutri-Score, less processed, less salt/sugar/saturated fat, more fiber/protein). Pass candidate barcodes, or omit them to search the product's own category.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Barcode of the original product |
| `alternativeBarcodes` | string[] | No | Candidate barcodes; omit to search the same category (1–10 items) |

#### Output

- `original`: object
- `found`: boolean
- `alternative` (optional): object
- `improvements`: string[]
- `candidatesConsidered`: number
- `searchedCategory` (optional): string
- `message`: string

#### Example

```json
// findHealthierAlternative({"barcode":"3017620422003","alternativeBarcodes":["7622210449283"]})
{
  "original": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella",
    "brand": "Nutella, Ferrero",
    "greenScore": "F",
    "novaGroup": 3
  },
  "found": true,
  "alternative": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince",
    "brand": "Mondelez Schweiz GmbH",
    "nutriScore": "E",
    "greenScore": "E",
    "novaGroup": 4
  },
  "improvements": [
    "Less saturated fat: 5.6 vs 10.6 per 100 g",
    "Less sugar: 32.0 vs 56.3 per 100 g",
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "candidatesConsidered": 1,
  "message": "Prince is a healthier alternative to Nutella"
}
```

### compareNutrientDensity

**Compare nutrient density** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Rank products by nutrient density (% Daily Value of beneficial nutrients per 100 kcal).

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes (2–10 items) |

#### Output

- `ranking`: object[]
- `mostNutrientDense`: string
- `missing`: string[]

#### Example

```json
// compareNutrientDensity({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"]})
{
  "ranking": [
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "density": 6
    },
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "density": 2
    }
  ],
  "mostNutrientDense": "7622210449283",
  "missing": []
}
```

### rankByNutrient

**Rank by nutrient** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Rank products by one nutrient per 100 g (e.g. highest protein, lowest sugars). Products without data go last.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes (2–10 items) |
| `nutrient` | string | Yes | Nutrient id, e.g. protein, fiber, sugars, salt, sodium, saturated_fat, energy_kcal |
| `ascending` | boolean | No | true = lowest first, false = highest first (default `true`) |

#### Output

- `nutrient`: string
- `sortOrder`: string
- `ranking`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]

#### Example

```json
// rankByNutrient({"barcodes":["3017620422003","7622210449283"],"nutrient":"sugars"})
{
  "nutrient": "sugars",
  "sortOrder": "lowest first",
  "ranking": [
    {
      "barcode": "7622210449283",
      "name": "Prince",
      "value": 32,
      "unit": "g"
    },
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "value": 56.3,
      "unit": "g"
    }
  ],
  "missing": []
}
```



## Price Tools

Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org). Prices in different currencies are never mixed.

### getProductPrices

**Get product prices** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Most recent crowdsourced prices for a product (newest first), with store and location.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |
| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |
| `limit` | integer | No | Maximum number of prices (1–100, default `20`) |

- `count`: number
- `prices`: object[]

### getPriceStats

**Get price statistics** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Min, max, average, median and latest price for a product, computed separately for each currency.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |
| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |

#### Output

- `barcode`: string
- `available`: boolean
- `priceCount`: number
- `byCurrency`: object[]
- `firstDate` (optional): string
- `lastDate` (optional): string
- `note`: string

#### Example

```json
// getPriceStats({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{
  "barcode": "3017620422003",
  "priceCount": 5,
  "byCurrency": [
    {
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 5,
      "min": 3.65,
      "max": 4.68,
      "avg": 4.26,
      "median": 4.45,
      "latest": {
        "price": 4.45,
        "date": "2026-10-06"
      }
    }
  ],
  "firstDate": "2026-08-28",
  "lastDate": "2026-10-06",
  "available": true,
  "note": "Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org); coverage varies by country and store. Statistics use up to the 100 most recent prices."
}
```

| `country` | string | No | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the store (e.g. FR, ES, US) |

- `barcode`: string
- `available`: boolean
- `bestPrices`: object[]

```json
// findBestPrice({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{

      "id": "325444",
```

### getPriceHistory

**Get price history** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Monthly median price of a product over the last months, per currency, to spot price trends.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `months` | integer | No |  (1–60, default `12`) |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |

#### Output

- `barcode`: string
- `months`: number
- `points`: object[]
- `trend`: `increasing` \| `decreasing` \| `stable` \| `insufficient_data`
- `note`: string

#### Example

```json
// getPriceHistory({"barcode":"3017620422003","months":60})
{
  "barcode": "3017620422003",
  "months": 60,
  "points": [
    {
      "month": "2026-08",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 2,
      "median": 4.27,
      "min": 4.05,
      "max": 4.49
    },
    {
      "month": "2026-09",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "count": 2,
      "median": 4.17,
      "min": 3.65,
      "max": 4.68
    },
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "trend": "stable",
  "note": "Crowdsourced prices from Open Prices (prices.openfoodfacts.org); coverage varies by country and store."
}
```

## Recipe & Meal Tools

Meal analysis, meal cost, ingredient substitutes and recipe ideas.

### suggestRecipes

**Suggest recipe ideas** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Recipe ideas that use a product, based on its categories, plus whether the product itself fits the requested diets. Ideas are starting points for the assistant to develop.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product to cook with |
| `diets` | `vegan` \| `vegetarian` \| `pescatarian` \| `keto` \| `paleo` \| `gluten_free` \| `dairy_free` \| `low_sodium` \| `low_sugar` \| `halal` \| `kosher`[] | No | Diets the recipe must respect (0–5 items) |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `categories`: string[]
- `ideas`: string[]
- `dietCheck`: object[]
- `tip`: string

#### Example

```json
// suggestRecipes({"barcode":"3017620422003","diets":["vegetarian"]})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"
  },
  "categories": [
    "breakfasts",
    "snacks",
    "… 3 more"
  ],
  "ideas": [
    "Banana and chocolate oat pancakes (small portion)",
    "Chocolate-dipped fruit",
    "… 1 more"
  ],
  "dietCheck": [
    {
      "diet": "vegetarian",
      "verdict": "compliant",
      "violations": []
    }
  ],
  "tip": "Ask for a full recipe for any idea; use substituteIngredient for diet-friendly swaps."
}
```

### substituteIngredient

**Substitute ingredient** — read-only · local computation · idempotent

Common substitutes for an ingredient (butter, egg, milk, cream, cheese, flour, sugar, honey, gelatin, soy sauce, breadcrumbs), filterable by need.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `ingredient` | string | Yes | Ingredient to replace (English or Spanish) |
| `need` | `vegan` \| `dairy_free` \| `egg_free` \| `gluten_free` \| `lower_calorie` \| `lower_sugar` | No | Only return substitutes suitable for this need |

#### Output

- `ingredient`: string
- `found`: boolean
- `substitutes`: object[]
- `knownIngredients` (optional): string[]

#### Example

```json
// substituteIngredient({"ingredient":"huevo","need":"vegan"})
{
  "ingredient": "huevo",
  "found": true,
  "substitutes": [
    {
      "substitute": "flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 3 tbsp water)",
      "ratio": "1 per egg",
      "notes": "Good for binding",
      "suitableFor": [
        "vegan",
        "egg_free"
      ]
    },
    {
      "substitute": "chia egg (1 tbsp chia + 3 tbsp water)",
      "ratio": "1 per egg",
      "notes": "Good for binding",
      "suitableFor": [
        "vegan",
        "egg_free"
      ]
    },
    "… 2 more"
  ]
}
```

### analyzeMealPlan

**Analyze meal plan** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Calories and macros per meal and for the whole day. Portions in grams per barcode (default 100 g).

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `meals` | object[] | Yes | Meals with their product barcodes (1–8 items) |
| `targetCalories` | integer | No |  (800–6000, default `2000`) |

#### Output

- `meals`: object[]
- `missing`: string[]
- `totalDailyCalories`: number
- `targetCalories`: number
- `macroSplit`: object
- `recommendation`: string

#### Example

```json
// analyzeMealPlan({"meals":[{"name":"Breakfast","barcodes":["3017620422003"],"grams":[20]},{"name":"Snack","barcodes":["7622210449283"]}]})
{
  "meals": [
    {
      "name": "Breakfast",
      "products": [
        {
          "barcode": "3017620422003",
          "name": "Nutella",
          "grams": 20,
          "calories": 108
        }
      ],
      "totalCalories": 108,
      "protein": 1.3,
      "carbs": 11.5,
      "fat": 6.2
    },
    {
      "name": "Snack",
      "products": [
        {
          "barcode": "7622210449283",
          "name": "Prince",
          "grams": 100,
          "calories": 467
        }
      ],
      "totalCalories": 467,
      "protein": 6.3,
      "carbs": 69,
      "fat": 17
    }
  ],
  "missing": [],
  "totalDailyCalories": 575,
  "targetCalories": 2000,
  "macroSplit": {
    "proteinPercent": 5,
    "carbsPercent": 57,
    "fatPercent": 37
  },
  "recommendation": "About 1425 kcal below the 2000 kcal target"
}
```

### calculateMealCost

**Calculate meal cost** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Estimated cost of a meal from crowdsourced median prices in one currency. With portions in grams, the cost is prorated by package size.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcodes` | string[] | Yes | Product barcodes in the meal (1–20 items) |
| `grams` | number[] | No | Portion in grams for each barcode (omit to cost whole packages) (0–20 items) |
| `currency` | string | No | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, MXN) |

#### Output

- `currency`: string \| null
- `items`: object[]
- `estimatedTotalCost`: number
- `itemsWithoutPrices`: string[]
- `missing`: string[]
- `note`: string

#### Example

```json
// calculateMealCost({"barcodes":["3017620422003"],"grams":[20]})
{
  "currency": "EUR",
  "items": [
    {
      "barcode": "3017620422003",
      "name": "Nutella",
      "packagePrice": 4.45,
      "portionCost": 0.22,
      "priceCount": 5
    }
  ],
  "estimatedTotalCost": 0.22,
  "itemsWithoutPrices": [],
  "missing": [],
  "note": "Median of crowdsourced prices (Open Prices); prices in other currencies are ignored."
}
```



## Insights Tools

Robotoff machine-learning predictions and data quality checks.

### getProductInsights

**Get product insights** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Machine-learning predictions about a product from Open Food Facts Robotoff (e.g. suggested categories, labels, brands) that are not yet confirmed.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `limit` | integer | No |  (1–50, default `10`) |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `insightCount`: number
- `insights`: object[]

#### Example

```json
// getProductInsights({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "3017620422003",
    "name": "Nutella"
  },
  "insightCount": 0,
  "insights": []
}
```

### getAIQuestions

**Get questions to verify** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Yes/no questions generated by Robotoff that need human verification, for one product or random products. Answering them on openfoodfacts.org improves the database.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | No | Product barcode (omit for random products) |
| `count` | integer | No |  (1–10, default `5`) |
| `lang` | string | No | Language of the questions (default `"en"`) |

#### Output

- `questionCount`: number
- `questions`: object[]
- `note`: string

#### Example

```json
// getAIQuestions({"barcode":"3017620422003"})
{
  "questionCount": 0,
  "questions": [],
  "note": "AI-generated suggestions; they need human verification before being applied."
}
```

### qualityCheck

**Check data quality** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Check how complete the data for a product is (nutrients, scores, ingredients, allergens, images) and what is missing.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | Yes | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |

#### Output

- `product`: object
- `qualityScore`: number
- `checks`: object
- `missingData`: string[]
- `sources`: string[]
- `recommendation`: string
- `contributeUrl` (optional): string

#### Example

```json
// qualityCheck({"barcode":"7622210449283"})
{
  "product": {
    "barcode": "7622210449283",
    "name": "Prince"
  },
  "qualityScore": 100,
  "checks": {
    "hasName": true,
    "hasBrand": true,
    "hasCategories": true,
    "hasCoreNutrients": true,
    "hasNutriScore": true,
    "hasGreenScore": true,
    "hasNovaGroup": true,
    "hasIngredients": true,
    "hasAllergenInfo": true,
    "hasImages": true
  },
  "missingData": [],
  "sources": [
    "openfoodfacts"
  ],
  "recommendation": "Comprehensive data.",
  "contributeUrl": "https://world.openfoodfacts.org/product/7622210449283"
}
```



## Safety Tools

US FDA food recalls (openFDA food enforcement reports, updated weekly).

### checkRecalls

**Check food recalls** — read-only · calls external APIs · idempotent

Search US FDA food recall / enforcement reports (openFDA) by barcode and/or product text. With only a barcode, the product name and brand are also searched. Matches by text are possible, not certain.

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `barcode` | string | No | Product barcode (EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A or GTIN-14), e.g. "3017620422003" |
| `query` | string | No | Product or brand words, e.g. "peanut butter" |
| `ongoingOnly` | boolean | No | Only recalls that are still ongoing (default `false`) |
| `limit` | integer | No |  (1–50, default `10`) |

#### Output

- `searched`: object
- `count`: number
- `recalls`: object[]
- `coverage`: string

#### Example

```json
// checkRecalls({"query":"peanut butter","limit":2})
{
  "searched": {
    "text": "peanut butter"
  },
  "count": 2,
  "recalls": [
    {
      "recallNumber": "H-1386-2026",
      "status": "Ongoing",
      "classification": "Class II",
      "reportDate": "2026-09-23",
      "recallInitiationDate": "2026-08-17",
      "recallingFirm": "Best Friends Bakery, LLC",
      "productDescription": "PUMPKIN SPICE NO BAKE COOKIE NET WT 3.5 oz. INGREDIENTS: WHOLE GRAIN OATS, MILK, MARGARINE***WATER, SALT, CONTAINS LESS THAN 2% OF THE FOLLOWING: SOY LECITHI…",
      "reason": "Peanuts & Eggs. The firm list peanuts in the ingredient statement but omitted them from the contain statement. They also have eggs listed in the contain stat…",
      "codeInfo": "Lot 20326",
      "distribution": "Product was shipped to the following states: AL, FL, GA, IN, KY, MI, OH, TN, VA &  WV.",
      "country": "United States",
      "matchedBy": "text"
    },
    {
      "recallNumber": "H-1034-2026",
      "status": "Terminated",
      "classification": "Class II",
      "reportDate": "2026-06-10",
      "recallInitiationDate": "2026-05-06",
      "recallingFirm": "Albertsons Companies LLC",
      "productDescription": "UPC 24144500000 Ready Meals PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP BAR With PRETZEL                       This is Albertson's store-made item and sold by unit at point…",
      "reason": "Contains statement does not declare Almond",
      "codeInfo": "Product was labeled with a Packed On date of May 05. 26 or before.",
      "distribution": "Nationwide.",
      "country": "United States",
      "matchedBy": "text"
    }
  ],
  "coverage": "United States (FDA-regulated foods), updated weekly. Classification: Class I = most serious health risk."
}
```
